name: selo-flow
description: A Claude Code plugin to spec, plan, implement and review web applications (front, API, database) with a disciplined, reviewed workflow.

plugins.name: selo-flow
plugins.description: The workflow: /selo-flow:init sets up the project, then write-spec, write-plan, implement, autopilot, grill-me and review run the spec → plan → code → review loop, driven by the project's selo-flow.yaml manifest.

plugins.name: selo-flow-board
plugins.description: A mod (function hooks) for selo-flow: a pane that lists the project's features, their dev plans and the stages running in other sessions, and prepares the next /selo-flow: prompt with one button.
